scope: all scalar leaves including array elements in three frozen YAML documents
interpretation: Config hash/equality proves identity, not parameter consumption. Declared-only values remain null. Legacy reproduction mode rejects every changed leaf. Registered R2 policy objects and source snapshots define the actual experiment; this is not a general YAML tuning interface.

actual_r2_runtime.label: decision-offset-v1 entry +1 / exit +6 / five complete 4h intervals; frozen predictions unchanged
actual_r2_runtime.training: no R2 return model fits; no R2 calibration fits; previous constant calibration reused
actual_r2_runtime.calendar: 12/3/3 months, step 3, purge12 bars plus actual label end, embargo1 bar
actual_r2_runtime.feature_validity: all_17_features for exact A0 comparability; separate trend_valid mask available and diagnosed, not switched in this matrix
actual_r2_runtime.quantity_precision: per-symbol CatMarket from frozen multi-asset manifest
actual_r2_runtime.legacy_caveat: strategy.instrument BTCUSDT and strategy quantity_step are not reused as all-asset market identities
